data.exact_reserve_text: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 37.6m (2014: strengthening of GBP 0.3m) was primarily driven by the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 54.7m (2014: release of GBP 15.8m), and Property and Fire release of GBP 5.3m (2014: release of GBP 3.6m).This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 23.4m (2014: strengthening of GBP 20.8m).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded an overall release of prior year claims reserves of approximately GBP 37.6m in 2015 (a ~6.4% reduction relative to opening gross claims reserves of GBP 587.4m). The release was driven principally by favourable development in Marine/Aviation portfolios (c.GBP 54.7m) and Property/Fire (c.GBP 5.3m), partially offset by adverse development in Third Party Liability (c.GBP 23.4m).
raw_causal_phrases: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 37.6m (2014: strengthening of GBP 0.3m)
the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 54.7m (2014: release of GBP 15.8m)
Property and Fire release of GBP 5.3m (2014: release of GBP 3.6m)
the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 23.4m (2014: strengthening of GBP 20.8m)

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from narrative 'Movement in Prior Year's Provision for Claims' (interpreted as GROSS). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions table. Claims development triangle is present but includes an aggregate '2010 & prior' column which complicates diagonal calculations; triangle mapping had ambiguous column alignment for the most recent years, so triangle-derived PYD was not used as primary source.
